title: GPU entitlement redistribution playbook — Oct 2026
content:
Purpose:
This working sheet defines a minimally disruptive process to redistribute unused or underutilized dedicated GPU entitlements between contracts and regions for Q4 2026. Focus is on short runway recovery, risk-limited migrations, and a small automated stress-test to validate performance post-move.

Scope:
- Only "dedicated" contract reservations (reserved A100-equivalent units) are in scope.
- Redistribution is allowed across regions within the same legal entity (NA-EAST, NA-WEST, EU-CENTRAL).
- No changes to customer billing tiers or contract terms in this run; moves are operational only and documented to finance.

Assumptions:
- A100-equivalent = baseline unit. For mixed hardware, we use performance weights in the table.
- Planned maintenance windows are 2 hours per region; moves attempted only in those windows.
- Networking and private deployments validated by Private infra team before any cross-region reassignment.

High-level risk model:
- Risk score: weighted sum of customer SLA sensitivity (0-5), blackout tolerance (0-5), and data residency constraints (0-5). Move allowed if score <= 6 or with explicit product approval.

Contract snapshot (real-time used for decision):
Columns: Contract | Customer | Region | Reserved (A100-eq) | Avg Utilization 30d (%) | Headroom (A100-eq) | HW Mix | RiskScore | MoveCandidate | Notes
Rows:
- CTR-2045 | CipherDocs | NA-EAST | 48 | 28% | 34 | A100x8 (1.0) | 3 | yes | long-tail batch jobs; prefers NA but tolerates NA-WEST
- CTR-2110 | ShopFlow | EU-CENTRAL | 32 | 76% | 8 | A100x8 (1.0) | 7 | no | peak retail traffic, do not touch
- CTR-2179 | NovaSearch | NA-WEST | 64 | 42% | 37 | A100x4 + H100x2 (1.2) | 4 | yes | can accept NA-EAST capacity
- CTR-2233 | MedForms | EU-CENTRAL | 16 | 12% | 14 | A100x4 (1.0) | 2 | yes | regulatory pinned to EU, moves only within EU
- CTR-2261 | FinStack | NA-EAST | 24 | 88% | 3 | A100x8 (1.0) | 9 | no | mission critical, engage account team before any action

Planned redistribution plan (initial pass):
- Source pools: underutilized contracts marked MoveCandidate=yes. Priority: lowest risk score, highest headroom.
- Target pools: contracts in same legal region with >10% utilization delta and headroom <10 A100-eq.
- Allocation rule: do not move more than 25% of any single contract's reserved capacity at once.

Example transfers (proposed):
- Move 12 A100-eq from CTR-2179 (NA-WEST) -> CTR-2045 (NA-EAST) via HA mirroring + cold KV migration. Rationale: CTR-2045 has low utilization and product accepts NA-WEST origin if latency validated.
- Move 8 A100-eq from CTR-2233 (EU-CENTRAL spare) -> new EU shared pool for short-term burst for marketing trials. Rationale: keep regulatory residency in EU while consolidating spare in single region pool.

Execution runbook (stepwise):
1) Pre-checks (D-3): confirm linked tickets, notify CS and Account teams, verify customer opt-outs using contract metadata.
2) Capacity lock (T-60m): mark source reservation as "move-locked"; reject new allocations from that slice.
3) Checkpoint: snapshot KV cache sizes and typical sequence lengths for impacted models.
4) Migrate: use infra migration toolchain to reassign reservation units in orchestration (internal tool: capacity-reassign v0.9). Do not change model pinning; update routing policy to prefer local region.
5) Smoke tests (T+15m): run synthetic latency and throughput tests against a small probe set (5% traffic synthetic).
6) Gradual ramp (T+30m): allow 10% real traffic, monitor 5 metrics: p50 latency, p95 latency, token/sec, error-rate, billing units consumed.
7) Full switch (T+120m): if all metrics within thresholds, release lock and mark migration complete.
8) Post-mortem (D+1): 24-hour monitoring, collect traces, update contract ledger, notify finance of operational move.

Rollback criteria:
- Any single metric degrades >30% relative to baseline for 15 continuous minutes, or any customer error-rate >0.5% sustained for 10 minutes.
- On rollback: invoke orchestration revert and run a focused cache warm-up on original region.

Stress test plan (automated):
- Small automated stress tests run 24h after move. Tests simulate production mix at 60% and 100% peaks for 15 minutes each.
- Success = no >10% increase in p95 and no outages during test. Fail triggers a gated alert to oncall and SRE lead and starts a rollback dry-run.

Capacity math appendix (quick):
- Effective capacity available for move = sum(headroom * hw_weight) across candidate contracts.
- Example: CTR-2179 headroom 37 with H100 weight 1.2 => effective 37 * 1.0 (normalize to A100-eq average) => conservative rounding down to 35 for safety margin.

Communication checklist:
- Pre-note to account manager and CS 72h before window.
- Slack bridge channel: #cap-ops-moves with ticket number in channel topic.
- Post-move email to stakeholders with metrics snapshot and any adjustments to routing.

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Should finance be charged for intra-entity moves? (action: finance ops to clarify by 2026-10-08, OWN: Priya)
- Automate risk scoring using contract tags? (action: infra research spike, OWN: Liam)

Action items (owners):
- Finalize acceptance criteria for CTR-2045 move — Maya (due 2026-10-02)
- Prepare capacity-reassign canary script and runbook — Diego (due 2026-09-30)
- Confirm regulatory compliance for EU pool consolidation — Priya (due 2026-10-05)

Notes to self: this doc is a working draft aimed at minimizing customer impact. Keep conservative thresholds for first two quarters of redistribution. Update ledger entries with original reservation timestamps for auditability.

Appendix: quick lookup table (A100-eq conversion factors)
- A100x8 = 1.00
- A100x4 = 0.50
- H100x2 = 1.20 (per org perf calibration)

End of sheet.
